pages.text: The Improved Processor is a mid-tier processor used to craft intermediate Refined Storage devices. It offers better performance than the Basic Processor but is less expensive than the Advanced Processor.
Features:$(li)Used in intermediate device recipes$(li)More efficient than Basic Processor$(li)Used in automation and processing components$(li)Balanced cost and performance
To craft the Improved Processor:$(li)First craft a Raw Improved Processor$(li)Smelt the Raw Improved Processor in a furnace$(li)Combine with Processor Binding$(li)Requires moderate resources
